evidence: Sheet row P09_r5. Round cherry-red faturan beads with fine dark speckles (matches the ROS-021 macros). Gourd imame with one ring over a cup-shaped lower bead, as in ROS-021-18. Gold cord with a gold woven ball and three gold openwork knot medallions, each under a small gold ball: same as ROS-021-16/17. The P09_r5 image is a near replica of ROS-021-16.

Sheet row P09_r6. Cherry barrel beads with fine dark specks. Gourd imame with ring, pink knot. Pale-gold woven cord ending in a maroon bead with a gold cap: all match ROS-057-1/3/6. Alternatives rejected on fittings: ROS-042 ends in a round gold woven medallion and its beads have black blotches; ROS-006 has silver coins, ROS-014 a silver 4-branch tassel, ROS-015 a gold openwork medallion; ROS-012 has rounder, lighter beads.

Sheet row P11_r3 ('German amber, speckled, multicolour, very rare'). Long rosary of long capsule/cylinder beads with rounded ends, roughly 50-60 of them, plus small round spacer beads. The beads are cream/butter, mottled and streaked with honey, red-brown and dark brown, partly translucent. Thin maroon cord, small ringed imame, and a tail of a few small beads ending in a small cylinder. No catalog piece has these: German-amber pieces are oval/barrel orange, and the KS cylinder pieces (ROS-KS-061/130/135) are plain yellow.

Confirmed. Oval orange-butterscotch beads with cream/yellow marbling. Imame of 3 beads split by two equal thin yellow rings. Red knot. Top tassel bead with a big cream blotch. 3 marbled drops with gold quatrefoil charms, and a small gold charm (the heart) at the chain junction. The video's tassel chains are wheat/spiga, but ROS-Amb-G-038-1/2 show a flat serpentine chain, so the chains were replaced after the photos. ROS-Amb-G-053 (thin ring + wide flat disc in the imame) and ROS-Amb-G-054 (darker cognac beads, thicker rings, nugget chain) differ.
Confirmed. Large caramel-orange barrel beads with red-brown veins and cream patches. Long stepped imame with butter rings. Red/black/green braided tassel on a red cord. Matches ROS-Amb-G-062-1..5.

Confirmed. Multicolour oval beads (butter, orange, dark cherry). Bottle imame with ring. Red braided cord with gold bands, an amber drop bead and a red silk tassel (kerkosha). Matches ROS-Amb-G-037-1..5.

Confirmed. Oval deep-orange/cognac beads. Imame: top bead, thin yellow ring, mid bead, then a wide flared yellow disc above a large bead, as in ROS-Amb-G-053-4. Plain uniform-orange top tassel bead, 3 amber drops with gold quatrefoil charms, red knot. The video chains are wheat/spiga; the catalog photos show a rolo/cable chain, so the tassel chains were swapped. v00 and v06 are clearly two different rosaries.

Confirmed. Lemon-honey glassy barrel beads with insects on a red thread. Same feather-like inclusion as ROS-B-004-5, the spider and the winged flies. The layout in video frame 3 is nearly identical to ROS-B-004-4.

Image only. About 66 round two-tone beads, each split into a dark brown translucent part and a honey-yellow opaque part (tiger-eye look). Orange carved imame with turned rings and a dark brown top. Red knot, pale-gold woven cord with knot fitting. No catalog piece has these two-tone round beads: checked ROS-Amb-G-045/041/051/026, ROS-010, and the KS/K galleries.

Image only; sheet says 'turned by Abdulaziz Karam'. Long rosary of opaque, uniform spinach-green barrel beads with tiny dark specks. Green flanged spool spacers, a long green conical imame with turned rings, and a green tail on a green cord. ROS-Amb-G-024 rejected: its beads shade olive to mustard-honey, it has orange disc spacers and orange rings in the imame, and it has a cream cord and fewer beads.

Image only, low resolution. Very dark cherry round beads with red glints (row named 'Sprkl', sheet says 'shiny/sparkling'), about 33 beads. Bottle imame with ring, red knot, black spacers, dark round tassel bead and three gold coins. ROS-004 and ROS-016 are built almost identically; the sheet shows a pale, cream-looking cord, which fits ROS-004's pale lemon cord rather than ROS-016's saturated gold. ROS-004 also has glitter particles, which fits the 'sparkle' name.

Image only. About 66 round beads, translucent honey-orange each with an opaque cream cap/zone (two-tone). Orange imame with a cream ring, red knot, pale-gold cord with woven knot fittings, ending in a tiny cluster of red/coral beads. Checked ROS-036/037/039/063, ROS-Amb-G-029/030, ROS-KS-005/007/020 and ROS-K-016; none match. ROS-KS-020 has lighter yellow beads, disc spacers and three openwork knots.
